verdict.rationale: Cactus exposes a hosted API (generations, training, billing), so a sandbox or test-mode environment is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents one. Running locally with needle_eval.py, or checking GET /billing before spending allowance, are adjacent workarounds rather than an isolated sandbox environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
